description: 1001 is building the Middle East’s Sovereign Artificial Intelligence Platform, an AI-native operating system that rewires how critical industries run. By embedding intelligence directly into operations across airports, ports, and mega-projects, 1001 turns live data into real-time decisions that save minutes, unlock capacity, and drive measurable performance gains.

1AP (1st Avenue Power) designs and builds fully integrated solar-plus-storage power plant systems that deliver firm, baseload clean electricity to utilities, data centers, and other large energy users. By engineering the generation, storage, power electronics, and software as a single system rather than assembling components from separate vendors, 1AP brings dispatchable clean power online faster, more reliably, and at lower cost than conventional approaches.

Using its AI-based technology platform, AGent Energy aggregates, orchestrates, and monetizes distributed generation resources in power markets, delivering significant reliability, economic, and sustainability benefits to large energy users, utilities, and grid operators. Founded by serial founders and energy industry veterans Stephanie Hendricks, and Fran Parker, AGent is unlocking a 185 GW resource in the ground today to support the rapid growth of electricity demand in the U.S.

APD is building a vertically integrated neocloud based in LatAm. Access to low-cost, abundant energy, a highly-skilled labor force, and leveraging existing networking infrastructure collectively create a structural advantage for APD.

ArgusEye is an AI-driven cybersecurity platform that automates threat modeling and product security beginning in the design phase of product development. The product is focused on embedded systems, software infrastructure, and AI-implementation. ArgusEye's Sentry platform reduces the manual threat modeling process from weeks to minutes, generating regulatory-ready deliverables and preemptively identifying threats throughout the product development lifecycle.
Base is a distributed battery-storage network providing grid flexibility on demand to balance intermittent renewable generation on the grid.

Calibre is a London-based company founded by ex-Palantir engineers building an agentic automation backbone for the Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) sector, designed to automate manual compliance workflows, accelerate audits, and digitize fragmented verification processes.
Crux is a marketplace to buy, sell, and trade the $1T+ market of transferable tax credits created by the Inflation Reduction Act.

General Biological is building a modular biomanufacturing platform that transforms low-cost carbohydrate feedstocks into high-value chemicals. Its non-sterile, high-yield fermentation process operates at room temperature, delivering a scalable, cost-efficient alternative to petrochemical production.

Giga Energy is a vertically integrated AI data center developer solving the industry’s most critical bottleneck: time to power. By designing and manufacturing key components in-house, Giga delivers powered land and turnkey AI data center systems significantly faster than traditional developers.

Hypercubic is building an agentic platform to understand and modernize COBOL mainframes. It captures comprehensive knowledge from legacy systems and subject matter experts, then uses that understanding to drive reliable, end-to-end modernization.

Isembard is accelerating manufacturing through advanced automation, proprietary software, and a franchise model that scales globally. Each Isembard factory integrates state-of-the-art machine tools, robotics, and MasonOS to deliver for customers with unmatched speed and quality. Through a franchising business model, Isembard creates a manufacturing network that can scale faster and cheaper than legacy companies.
Mundane is a new type of robot company. Focusing on mundane tasks, we prioritize real world deployments over meaningless lab demos.

Senra Systems is transforming wire harness manufacturing through advanced automation and proprietary software. By integrating cutting-edge machinery and intelligent process controls, Senra delivers complex harnesses with unprecedented speed and precision, compressing lead times from months to weeks.

Shinkei Systems is reinventing seafood processing through advanced robotics and vertical integration. Its robot mimics the Japanese technique of Shinkei-Jime to deliver ultra-fresh, high-grade fish under the premium Seremoni brand, now featured in Michelin-star restaurants and select retailers.

Sift is accelerating the way modern machines are built - enabling teams to build hardware like software. Their observability platform and purpose-built data infrastructure automate much of the testing and analysis required to develop mission-critical machines, reducing risk, cost, and time to market.

Starpilot is a robotics and physical AI company that partners with factory operators to gather and monetize operational data, optimize physical systems, and ultimately automate labor-intensive processes with intelligent, autonomous robotics.

The Nuclear Company is a fleet-scale nuclear development company based in America’s heartland. The company leverages advanced manufacturing techniques together with proven technology, approved regulatory pathways, and co-located demand to deliver nuclear on time and on budget.

Turgon is an AI-native System Integrator, built by repeat founders / entrepreneurs, to radically improve how System Integration projects are delivered -- 5x faster, 66% cheaper. We are building and training multiple AI Agents to work alongside skilled engineers to help enterprises modernize their data infrastructure, delivering value in weeks, not months or years.

Unlimited Industries is building a next-gen engineering, procurement, and construction ("EPC") firm with Forge, an AI-native platform that replaces labor-heavy workflows and aligns with developers to deliver construction projects faster and cheaper, with a particular focus on critical infrastructure.
Verse uses advanced software, generative AI, and optimization techniques to streamline clean energy procurement and management.
